name: GWE World Champion
epitaph: Named in the fed's own 4 November 1997 founding pitch (five titles: World, Pacific, Atlantic, Middle Crown, and Tag Team) alongside a weekly/bi-weekly/monthly card structure. No bestowal, holder or result of any kind survives.
